questions.prompt:
(a) State what is meant by diffraction of a wave.

(b(i)) A beam of vertically polarised light of wavelength 540 nm is incident normally on a diffraction grating, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
Show that the angle θ at which the first-order bright fringe is formed is 6.2°.

(b(ii)) Determine the value of θ at which the second-order bright fringe is formed.

(b(iii)) On Fig. 4.2, sketch the variation of the intensity I with θ for values of θ from −15° to +15°.

(c) A polarising filter is placed in the path of the light beam that is incident on the diffraction grating in Fig. 4.1. The transmission axis of the filter is at 45° to the vertical.

Suggest how the variation of intensity with θ for the light on the screen compares with the answer in (b)(iii).
